## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally (62+ tests, all gates green)
- [ ] New or changed rules: linked to a public upstream issue or documentation
- [ ] New or changed rules: complete zh-CN title, summary, and actions
- [ ] New or changed rules: `node scripts/validate-rule.mjs <file>` passes
- [ ] No credentials, private repository names, usernames, or unredacted home paths added
- [ ] Suggested actions are reversible and read-only where possible
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, schema, or contracts changed
